title: Lesson tuning file
description: The audio choices for one lesson, written by the user after listening. Everything except schema_version and lesson is optional; missing values fall back to the language defaults in languages.json, then to 100 ms for pauses. Speed and mode do not apply to a language whose engine is recording.

lesson.description: Id of the lesson this file tunes, for example lesson-01.

default_speed.description: Speed of the target language voice for sentences without their own speed.

meaning_speed.description: Speed of the meaning language voice, for all sentences.

phrase_pause_ms.description: Silence between the pieces of a sentence in phrases mode, for sentences without their own value.

sentences.description: Settings for single sentences, keyed by sentence id.

mode.description: whole (default) plays the sentence in one piece; phrases plays the pieces from `phrases` in the lesson file, joined with a pause.
